title: Unix Timestamp Converter
seoTitle: Unix Timestamp Converter – Epoch to Date
description: Convert Unix seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, or nanoseconds to UTC, local, and a time zone, or a date back to epoch. It stays in your browser.
indexDescription: Convert a Unix timestamp to UTC, your local time, and another IANA time zone, or turn a date back into epoch seconds. Seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds are chosen from the digit count. A JWT exp, iat, or nbf value is read as seconds.
